display.purpose: Bundled Baloo 2 makes one dominant pre-match declaration; compact Unity UI type carries utility text.

label.purpose: Uppercase broadcast metadata, status, roster roles, and technical annotations.

shadows.name: title-offset
shadows.purpose: Hard printed offset behind the main display title.

shadows.name: structural-edge
shadows.purpose: Bottom edge that gives primary controls a stamped, pressable silhouette.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Short decisive hover, focus, and press translation.

motion.name: hud-feedback
motion.purpose: Brief scale, translate, opacity, and color feedback for combat readouts.

narrative.overview: A handmade fight poster became a live game broadcast. Cool fighting imagery leads; dry jokes and rough print gestures support it without obscuring the player's next action.
keyCharacteristics: Underground fight-poster energy with disciplined hierarchy.
Square geometry, heavy borders, and offset physical layering.
Rounded, heavy display type paired with compact utility labels.
Dry self-aware copy that never obscures status.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Acid and Combat Orange may both exist on a screen, but one accent owns each region.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Use borders, offsets, and layers before blur, glow, or ambient shadow.

rules.name: The Declaration Rule
rules.body: Give each composition one loud phrase. Supporting labels are smaller, quieter, and useful.

dos: Do establish the grid before adding crooked poster gestures.
Do make focus, selected, disabled, and confirmation states more obvious than texture.
Do keep gameplay HUD texture restrained and information stable.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, glassmorphism, soft ambient shadows, or glossy gradients by default.
Don't rotate dense information or required actions.
Don't use color as the only status indicator.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Acid, square, bordered, and physically pressable.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#FFC821; color:#17131B; border:2px solid #0D0D14; border-bottom-width:6px; padding:0 18px; min-height:56px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background:#FFD95C; border-color:#F0EEE8; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(3px); }

components.name: Hot Button
components.description: Combat-orange action for host, join, or other high-energy paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-hot { background:#E05C2A; color:#17131B; border:2px solid #0D0D14; border-bottom-width:6px; padding:0 18px; min-height:56px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-btn-hot:hover,.ds-btn-hot:focus-visible { background:#FF7650; border-color:#FFC821; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-hot:active { transform:translateY(3px); }

components.name: Broadcast Status Pill
components.description: Compact ink strip for live status, roster metadata, and technical labels.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display:inline-block; background:#17131B; color:#F0EEE8; padding:8px 12px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; border-left:8px solid #FFC821; }
